handoffSay.text: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Domingo Lim is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
🕯️ Domingo Lim is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Booker blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
📖 LEARNED: Field Dressing (Level 1). Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.
📖 LEARNED: Anatomy (Level 1). You know where the important bits are. Arteries, joints, organs. Useful for healing or hurting.
📖 LEARNED: Food Preservation (Level 1). Salt, smoke, dry. The big three. Salt draws water out; bacteria can't live without it.
🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
📖 The Codex turns a page: Domingo Lim, 16 days. The mantle passes to Booker Cox.
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Booker Cox, 38 — a Butcher.
The fire knew Booker before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
